notes.title: Update 1.1: Bug Fixing and Quality Improvements
notes.content:
[h2]Great news! 🙌[/h2]

The first regular update has arrived to the game, here are the patch notes:

[h3]Bug Fixing:[/h3]
Fixed an annoying bug that allowed overlapping of infinite pause menus when in Interludes.
Fixed bug that broke the character in the Level Selection, depending on the order when equipping certain skins. Now they are displayed correctly regardless of the order.
Fixed bug that didn't start animations when entering levels with certain skins.

[h3]Balancing: [/h3]
Level 9_4 has more enemies and less Snipers, to make it more interesting.

[h3]Quality Improvements:[/h3]
Updated pre-text when entering levels to show less text and better display of information
Updated Japanese font to support all characters of this language
Text informing of the extra levels is displayed upon completion of the main story. This only happens once
Smoothed the explosion of the Level 9 Interlude and added vibration with controller
The equipped skin is focused when entering the Change Avatar with a controller

Remember to update the game to get all the improvements. This update will arrive at a later date for all platforms.

[h1]Don't forget to write a review if you haven't done so, this helps the game a lot![/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1839860/Die_Again/

notes.title: Small patch: Fixed a couple bugs from some specifics possession
notes.content:
First small patch, 

We have fixed a couple of bugs that broke the game if a particular type of enemy died in the player's range and the player was in the body of an specific enemy. 
The previous result was that the game over screen did not appear, not allowing to restart the level and "freezing" the game.

Now the game over screen appears correctly and the player can respawn

Although it is not necessary, we recommend upgrading to this latest version to avoid this annoying error

This bug fix will arrive on all console version of the game on a later date
